text:
maria: Heads up — SRE flagged an embeddings latency spike in Europe. Need customer-facing status wording + timing for status page, targeted emails, and any webinar messaging.
aj: Seeing p99 spike in eu-west-1 starting ~10:12 UTC. SRE running mitigation steps, ETA unclear.
sara: For the status page keep it short: "Degraded performance for embeddings in Europe region. Engineers investigating; no data loss expected. Next update in 30 minutes."
maria: I want a slightly warmer tone for customers on paid plans — add "we're prioritizing impacted customers" line. Also: do we hold tomorrow's webinar?
ken: Support queue is already seeing inbound tickets referencing timeouts. Suggest routing affected accounts >50k monthly units to AE on-call. I'll prep a Zendesk macro.
dev-rel: Pause any benchmark tweets or blog pushes that reference EU numbers until we confirm stability.
statusbot: Incident created: INC-2026-341 — embeddings latency in eu-west-1. Draft statuspage update posted to staging.
aj: Draft statuspage suggestion: "We are experiencing intermittent latency for embeddings in our Europe region. Engineers are investigating; no data loss expected. Next update by 10:50 UTC." Keep it 1-2 sentences.
sara: Add a short 'affected features' list: embeddings API, semantic search, vector reranking. Also include contact link for SLA requests.
maria: Email cadence proposal: publish status page now; targeted email to customers with >50k embeddings in last 7 days in 20 mins; broad customer email (all registrants) after 40 mins; public social post after 60 mins.
ken: Zendesk macro ready id: `macro_eu_embeds_4521`. Support template: 
```
Subject: Re: Embeddings timeouts
Body: Hi <name>, we're aware of intermittent latency in EU embeddings. We're prioritizing recovery. Please share request id and we'll route to your rep. - Support
```
dev-rel: Quick translation needs: FR/DE/ES. I can ping vendor for fast-turn (ETA ~25 mins).
maria: Draft email copy (targeted):
```
Subject: Redwood Inference — temporary latency impacting embeddings in Europe
Hi <FirstName>,
We're investigating intermittent latency impacting embeddings in our Europe region. Our engineers are working with priority and we expect to report next status by 10:50 UTC. If you're experiencing timeouts, reply to this email and we'll route you to your support rep.
Apologies for the disruption — Maria (Marketing)
```
ken: Add a link to the status page and an SLA credit request form link.
statusbot: Status updated: mitigation applied -> partial recovery. Next update scheduled by 11:05 UTC.
aj: SRE reports p99 improving; recommend follow-up update at 11:05 to confirm stabilization before broad public comms.
sara: Webinar notice: Recommend we put tomorrow's "Production inference tuning" webinar on hold and message registrants only: "Webinar on hold due to service disruption; registrants will be updated with new date." Don't publicize postponement yet.
maria: Agreed. I'll send the registrant email only once we have official reschedule.
dev-rel: Also put the scheduled benchmark tweet (15:00 UTC) on hold and cancel the publishing job.
maria: Routing note — route high-value inbound leads affected by this to #sales-urgent with a short summary and customer contact. aj can you confirm automation?
aj: Automation in place; will forward leads matching >50k usage and enterprise tag to #sales-urgent via our routing webhook.
maria: Ok final checklist before publish: 1) Approve statuspage line (aj) 2) Email draft approved (sara + ken) 3) Translations kicked (dev-rel) 4) Webinar paused (sara) 5) Benchmark posts paused (dev-rel) 6) Lead routing enabled (aj).
aj: All checked except translations pending (vendor pinged).
sara: Email copy approved from product POV. Add a one-liner about feature impact in the first sentence.
maria: Updated and publishing now. Posting statuspage + targeted emails per schedule. Will hold broad social until SRE confirms stable. :thumbsup:
statusbot: Status updated -> partial recovery. Next update: confirmed stabilization or regression.
ken: Support macros live. I'll notify support team in #support.
maria: Thanks all — reopening thread if regression. Closing for now.
